sources.title: ESMFold2 Protein Structure Prediction | Biohub Platform
sources.snippet: ESMFold2 ESMFold2 is the successor to ESMFold that sets a new state of the art for single-sequence structure prediction and enables the generation of new functional proteins through searching the ESMC model's latent space. sources.title: esmfold2/README.md at main · atong01/esmfold2 · GitHub
sources.snippet: ESMFold2, built on the ESMC 6B model, is a state-of-the-art structure prediction model that has been validated for the design of protein-protein interactions. ESMFold2 surpasses other models in DockQ pass-rate on Foldbench protein-protein and antibody-antigen complexes, and can be used in single-sequence mode for an order of magnitude speedup in folding.
